summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $4,671,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due September 30, 2032, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100 Index and Russell 2000 Index, priced at $1,000 per note with an issue date of September 30, 2026. This is a routine structured note takedown, not a special situation. Watch credit spread and index volatility, as principal is at risk if the worst-performing underlying breaches its threshold.
